fusions.name: Beater's Surge
fusions.desc: Sends a surge of water at the first enemy it meets that deals 26 damage, knocks it back 2 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. If it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Lapping Nip
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 5 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Rescue Swim
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second for 6 seconds to the ally who needs it most.

fusions.name: Marsh Retriever
fusions.desc: A bonded Marsh Retriever fights beside you. Every 1.2 seconds it deals 3 damage to an enemy within 4 tiles, and each kill it makes restores 5 health to you.
